## 维护者速读
改了什么:showcase 五个记录级动作的成功提示现在点名被改的记录，英文如 "PII access review marked done."、发票 "INV-1002 submitted for finance + legal sign-off.";示例应用自带的中文语言包里四条译文同样点名，如「个人信息访问审查已标记为完成。」。只改 `examples/app-showcase` 的动作文案、该示例的中文语言包、一个钉住提示原文的测试和一个 changeset。
为什么改：连续标记多条任务完成时只看到 "Task marked done." 或「任务已标记为完成。」,分不清改的是哪一条;裁决 C(#25849)要求记录级写操作点名记录或数量，中英文用户都应如此(#26459)。
风险与回滚：只动示例应用的文案;行里没带出标题列时，中英文都退回原来的对象措辞，不会出现空白或原样的占位符。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
先看:`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` 的五处 successMessage → `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` 中 zh-CN 的四条 → 测试 `examples/app-showcase/test/record-action-success-names-record.test.ts`。
两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/record-action-success-names-record.test.ts`,预期 18 个用例全过。
需要你做的：无，席位落地。
席位意见:ACCEPT(补一轮后)。首轮只改了英文，席位要求补上示例应用自带的中文译文(认领里禁改的「语言包」指 `ui/packages/i18n`,不含示例自己的翻译包);PR 正文验收备注里「中文译文未改」已过时，以本记录为准。英文标题接中文无空格(如「PII access review已标记为完成。」)是为了让无标题时的退回文案与原文逐字相同，接受。

## 席位核对
seat 2 · 2026-10-27T10:29Z · head `bb657a00` (#26459)

| item | reading |
|---|---|
| form | 4 files, +163/−9: five `successMessage` strings in `ui/actions/index.ts` use the record.title hole (record.name, the invoice number, for invoices) with the `default` formatter falling back to the old object wording; four zh-CN entries in the showcase's own bundle do the same (Submit for Sign-off has no zh-CN entry); 18-cell pin (en + zh, named + fallback); root `.changeset/` patch on `@objectstack/example-showcase` (private, not in the changesets ignore list) |
| premise measured | `ActionRunner.composeSuccessMessage` fills holes over two roots, `result` and `record` (the clicked row, else the page's record); `useActionTextLocalizer` swaps in the bundle entry before the run, and i18next passes the hole through untouched (existing pin `useActionTextLocalizer.templateEnvelope-13367`); the selection bar runs the bulk action with its toast off, so the selection-wide message only shows from one record's overflow menu |
| gates (check-runs on `bb657a00`) | 28 success, 11 skipped, 0 failing (examples-only diff: the ui jobs are path-skipped). Local: round 1 red 6/10, round 2 red 5/18, green 18/18; showcase suite 40 files / 502 tests; typecheck exit 0; `objectstack validate` passed; `check-sdui-manifest` exit 0; 49 of 50 derived gates exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (needs every package's dist), left to CI |
| accepted deviations | the PR body's acceptance note on zh-CN is stale (corrected here; the body is not edited after `pr_create`); PR body puts `Fixes #26459` before the declaration lines |
| out of scope | `GenerateInvoicePdfAction` copy ("The PDF is attached to the invoice.") and the QA checklist variant text quoting "Task marked done." (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`, the QA seat's) |
| landing | not governed (`check-governed-merges`: 172 changed lines, no hit paths); `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` c8ed4c99 clean; no other open PR on these files |
